title: Piercing Frame Solo #207 (일반 얼굴 컷 · P5 정의형 · 일반 · 프렌치브레이드 · 비비드바이올렛 · 메이크업 노르딕발키리 · 금속 금·보석 자수정)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the base of her neck and the tops of her collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Norwegian woman — fair skin with a light scatter of freckles, strong straight defined dark-blonde brows, warm bronze shadow across the lids, a fine brown liner, long lashes, large pale-blue eyes with bright real catchlights, soft contour, a muted red-brown lip, a fierce, steady, commanding expression, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in a classic French braid from the crown. Real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded.

Piercings: A big yellow-gold segment ring on each ear with a small yellow-gold stud above it on the left; a small yellow-gold ring passes through the left nostril; a thin yellow-gold bar passes through the outer end of the left eyebrow. Each piece carries small amethysts set into the metal. All jewelry is real yellow gold, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Lighting: a soft frontal beauty light on the face with a thin cool rim light along the hair, pure pitch black void background, shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
